meta.title: OntoShip chain board
meta.description: Right-sidebar board of the current OntoShip unit: one ticket-DAG with a dependency graph and a Kanban whose blocked column is computed from edges and whose ready column is the computed frontier. Status colors follow the Temporal UI palette. Reads tickets and edges from tickets/<slug>/ and state from docs/ops/continue.md in the session working folder, refreshes on file changes, and stores nothing: every view is derived from markdown + git.

tab.title: Chain board
tab.description: The current unit as one ticket-DAG: dependency graph and Kanban from tickets/ and continue.md.

empty.noContinue: No docs/ops/continue.md in the working folder. The board shows OntoShip units only.
